title: Understanding Vape Counter-Marketing Study
official: Countering E-Cigarette Marketing in the Retail Environment Among Adolescents and Young Adults
summary: The goal of this interventional study is to test whether short videos of electronic-cigarette (e-cigarette) counter-marketing lessons work to decrease people's intent to use and smoke e-cigarettes. Using short videos, the investigators hope to inform participants about the marketing strategies that e-cigarette companies use to try to get people to purchase and use e-cigarettes. The investigators hope to find that, after watching the short videos, people will be able to point out when e-cigarette companies are trying to sell their products, and hopefully they will have a lower interest in buying and using e-cigarettes. The investigators also hope participants will learn more about the addictiveness and harmfulness of using e-cigarettes by watching the short videos.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 13-21 years old
* Fluent in English
* Owns a smartphone or other device that can be used to complete study activities (e.g., watching videos, responding to electronic surveys)
* Meets sampling ratio to match the US Census for sex assigned at birth, race, and ethnicity

Exclusion Criteria:

* Fails survey validation checks (e.g., completing the survey too quickly, providing the same answer to every question)
